description: A fast, small text and code editor for Windows 10 and 11.
notes: TriPad keeps its settings and unsaved text in %APPDATA%\TriPad, so updating keeps them.
It doesn't update itself when Scoop installed it: 'scoop update tripad' does.
pre_install: # The zip's TriPad.ini makes TriPad keep everything beside TriPad.exe, in a folder each update replaces.
# Scoop's persist can't keep it either: TriPad saves by swapping in a new file, which a hard link doesn't follow.
